assumptions.finding: Order and document status changes drive the described business process.
assumptions.limitation: The exact trigger mechanism is not stated; events and polling schedules remain plausible.

assumptions.finding: The source reports growing order demand, without executions per day.
assumptions.limitation: Revenue is not run volume. The retained daily value means dozens/day and is only hypothetical.

assumptions.finding: Identity documents and customer emails support personal and visible flags.
assumptions.limitation: This is an engineering interpretation, not an exhaustive risk assessment.

assumptions.finding: Reviewed the case and service privacy policy; neither establishes unrestricted workflow deployment.
assumptions.limitation: Third-party apps do not establish permission to use arbitrary hosting or model providers.

assumptions.finding: The founder ran a web design business and built multi-step integrations.
assumptions.limitation: This suggests technical comfort; the exact mid-level operator capability is not verified.

assumptions.finding: The scoped workflow retrieves context and uses AI to assemble a report for staff.
assumptions.limitation: Judgement is a reasonable mapping of that bounded workflow; it is not the entire support process.

assumptions.finding: Day-to-day use is reported, but not the count of investigation runs.
assumptions.limitation: Daily use does not prove dozens/day.

assumptions.finding: Support records include identity and contact information, supporting the personal flag.
assumptions.limitation: Exact fields accessible to the n8n workflow are not documented.

assumptions.finding: The service policy covers handling of customer information.
assumptions.limitation: It does not specify permissible n8n hosting or model processing locations.

assumptions.finding: The case describes investigation/reporting without a support request taxonomy.
assumptions.limitation: No is an unverified simplification, not proof that routing is unnecessary.

assumptions.finding: Reports assemble case information, but a report acceptance rubric is unpublished.
assumptions.limitation: Partly means subjective quality in the UI. Publication silence does not establish subjectivity; retain only as a sensitivity baseline.

assumptions.finding: The workflow consults a case database and historical context.
assumptions.limitation: Reference inputs are supported; reference-only sufficiency and absence of learned memory are not established.

assumptions.finding: Context collection logically precedes delivery of the structured report.
assumptions.limitation: The article does not rule out parallel retrieval; sequential is a top-level abstraction.

assumptions.finding: Jobs generate data and the custom backfill plugin clears generated data.
assumptions.limitation: Act describes writes and deletions, not just reads.

assumptions.finding: Thousands of regularly executing tasks support high aggregate orchestration volume.
assumptions.limitation: This mapping covers the described fleet, not the frequency of any single DAG.

assumptions.finding: Merchant-facing payment reports and destructive custom backfills support visible, confidential-data and costly-error risks.
assumptions.limitation: Flags are our interpretation of the scoped fleet; they do not imply every task performs a payment.

assumptions.finding: The platform lineage required on-premise operation; infrastructure policy describes company-managed servers and payment-data locations.
assumptions.limitation: Residency is the closest available encoding of controlled deployment. Historical evidence and wider policy do not specify every current Airflow DAG.

assumptions.finding: The service creates workflow files, updates metadata and launches jobs.
assumptions.limitation: These are write/execute operations.

assumptions.finding: The engineering account explicitly describes varying frequency and concurrency.
assumptions.limitation: Concurrent task capacity does not prove a daily execution count for this scoped workload.

assumptions.finding: Authentication, authorization and workload isolation are documented.
assumptions.limitation: These controls do not establish that all outputs are internal/easy to fix; none remains an unverified baseline.

assumptions.finding: The historical service runs on Azure with separated service clusters.
assumptions.limitation: Observed cloud deployment does not prove unrestricted deployment permission.

assumptions.finding: Customers upload files and staff supply them to the migration agent.
assumptions.limitation: This does not settle whether execution begins with a manual request or an upload event.

assumptions.finding: Customer and file counts are described without migration executions/day.
assumptions.limitation: Thousands of customers is not daily run volume.

assumptions.finding: The company describes governed third-party AI use and secure migration storage.
assumptions.limitation: Policy does not identify migration-specific locations or permit arbitrary providers.

assumptions.finding: The scoped goal is one migration outcome across CSV, Excel and SQL formats.
assumptions.limitation: Different formats may require routed parsing; a single goal does not prove one handling path.

assumptions.finding: An explicit destination schema and validated JSON support checklist-based acceptance.
assumptions.limitation: Schema validity alone does not prove semantic correctness; field/value reconciliation still needs testing.

assumptions.finding: The target onboarding schema supplies concrete reference material.
assumptions.limitation: Published details do not establish whether reference alone suffices or additional playbooks are used.

assumptions.finding: Interactive and service-account API access are both documented.
assumptions.limitation: Manual is one scenario; calling applications can trigger retrieval automatically.

assumptions.finding: The articles/API guide do not publish absolute query executions per day.
assumptions.limitation: Enterprise scale and API availability are not traffic measurements.

assumptions.finding: Clients receive citation-backed financial answers, supporting visible output.
assumptions.limitation: The flag is not an exhaustive characterization of data licensing or confidentiality.

assumptions.finding: The API requires authentication and documents controlled dataset access.
assumptions.limitation: Access control does not establish geographic hosting or provider constraints.

assumptions.finding: Routing, exact-match retrieval and completeness are explicitly evaluated.
assumptions.limitation: That supports clear criteria; it does not prove complete coverage or perfect reliability.

assumptions.finding: Verified datasets are essential retrieval references.
assumptions.limitation: The publications do not establish reference-only sufficiency or rule out additional playbooks.

assumptions.finding: Table materializations and production merges write derived data.
assumptions.limitation: Act is appropriate for the scoped data operations.

assumptions.finding: The article reports about 4,000 daily materializations.
assumptions.limitation: High applies to the described aggregate system, not necessarily one table.

assumptions.finding: The article describes production merge races and consistency-sensitive backfills.
assumptions.limitation: None is not supported. Precise cost/reversibility is unknown, so compare costly-error and confidential-data scenarios.

assumptions.finding: The system uses Kubernetes, BigQuery and Dagster hybrid cloud.
assumptions.limitation: Those choices do not disclose all location restrictions; cloud use is not unrestricted permission.

searchNotes: Re-read all seven original cases and searched company-authored engineering, support, API and privacy publications.

Targeted searches covered Bordr order triggers/operator background; Oversee support/security; Adyen data-platform scale/hosting; Adobe orchestration; Remote migration/AI handling; Kensho API/quality/traffic; Discord operations.
Privacy pages provide handling context only; this is not a legal interpretation or evidence of unrestricted deployment.
Kensho overview was returned in search but direct opens failed twice; it is not a validated link in this ledger. The opened API guide and engineering article provide the cited evidence.

Koralplay provides a concrete high-volume and routed support comparison; ITNT documents controlled self-hosting with selective cloud-model use. Neither proves Bordr or Oversee has identical constraints.
No exact source was found for remaining unknowns in this bounded research pass. Absence of published evidence is not evidence of absence.
